subject.title: feat(ui): add settings profile page with lifetime token stats, streaks, and activity heatmap

question: Should OpenClaw core ship this new `/settings/profile` page and the additive `sessions.usage` aggregate fields as the implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102841?
rationale: The PR adds a new core Control UI surface and API-adjacent response fields; the linked issue and PR have protected maintainer-review/product-decision signals, so automation should not decide the product direction.

options.title: Review after repair and proof
options.body: Keep this PR open, require the i18n lifecycle fix plus real-Gateway proof, then review the feature/API direction for merge.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Ask the author to split or reduce the UI widgets and gateway aggregate additions before deciding whether core should own the profile surface.

options.title: Decline core profile surface
options.body: Close the PR and linked issue only if maintainers decide a wrapped-style profile page should not live in core Control UI.

recommendation.title: Review after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require the i18n lifecycle fix plus real-Gateway proof, then review the feature/API direction for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked feature request and implementation and have recent current-main history on the relevant usage and route surfaces.
